digest.component_or_area: CLI command-line interface and argument parsing
propositions: Core commands in _commands, _engine_support, and _io currently parse argv imperatively without shared argparse factories, creating grammar duplication that RP-05 eliminates
Each migrated command must move its grammar into a side-effect-free S2a-contract factory in _cli/_parsers/core/ and wire its parser_factory reference onto the command's Route in _registry.py
Per-command factories must preserve their family's existing unknown-token semantics (parse_known_args skip vs reject-exit-2), proven by negative tests, without normalizing to argparse defaults

Router-level global flag extraction (--output, --quiet, --allow-secret-pattern) runs before per-command factories on the pre--- segment; factories parse only the command-local tail and do not re-declare globals
All 49 core command handlers must route through their wired parser_factory with no parallel imperative grammar remaining, while metrics (already migrated in S2c) is excluded from this ticket
